public.title: Container With Most Water
public.description: Choose two indices i and j with i before j to maximize (j-i) times the smaller height. Return that area, or 0 when fewer than two heights exist. There are 0 to 1000 nonnegative integer heights at most 10000.
hints: Start with the widest pair, then move the shorter side inward.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Moving the taller side cannot improve the area while the shorter side remains fixed. Discard the shorter side each step, using O(n) time.
